title: evals/scenarios/<name>.json
description: One eval scenario: a fixture, an intake path, an owner persona and the run's budgets.

name.description: Equals the file name without its extension.

fixture.description: A directory under fixtures/ holding owner-brief.md.

intake.description: How the working semantic root starts.

path.description: connection: the project and one source exist; the skill agent carries on from sl status.

views.description: View name -> relation; {fixture} is replaced by the fixture directory, relative to the semantic root.

script.description: Canned turns for the scripted driver, relative to the scenario file.

grading.description: What the graders (evals/graders/) compare a run with.

figures.description: A figure mapping file (eval-figures.schema.json), relative to the scenario file.

selection.description: Source -> the tables the owner's brief puts in scope, by name or schema.table.

protected_columns.description: table.column of the fixture's data whose values never appear in a run's files, beside those the sensitivity rules flag.
